main_question: Under a fixed public preprocessing and verifiable synthetic workload, which admission rule meets interactive latency and background/throughput limits; does online margin add useful value over a strong public fixed rule?

final_directives.extract: 对下列编号返回资料中的对应数值：{targets}。每行ID|值，不写其他内容。
final_directives.organize: 依照给出的编号列表逐行输出对应值：{targets}。严格保持列表顺序，每行ID|值。

formal_data.calibration_cv: not applicable: public rule point has no fitted parameters; initial fallback uses maximum positive calibration residual per bucket
formal_data.final_source_sharing: same32 source rows per block for main and boundary;392xx retired unused

development_directives.extract: 提取以下编号对应的数值：{targets}。每行ID|值，不写其他内容。
development_directives.organize: 按以下编号顺序整理对应的数值：{targets}。每行ID|值，不写其他内容。

search.reference_rule: max of class-conditional type7 P75 of calibration public-rule-point costs; margin0; no grammar floor
search.common_selection_reference: B3 at fixed empirical initial calibration margin; 3 budgets x3 aging x3 development blocks
search.ranking: feasible first (I P95<=1000ms,B P95 cost<=20%,output rate loss<=5%, complete accounting); then median I P95,B P95,rate loss,fixed candidate order; report per-block ranges; if none feasible freeze representative by same order and declare no feasible candidate
search.common_serviceability_gate: on B3 margin0 public probe, each class has at least one source with own cost<=Q and at least one ordinary native admission per class; at max reference budget Q; if absent stop common configuration freeze and amend, never choose by M wins
search.NN_tau: weighted calibration actual-output P85; each calibration sample weight=230-trace allocation for its class/task/target_count divided by calibration stratum count; first sorted value reaching85% total weight; ties short

formal.predeclared_equivalence: merge only configurations with proved identical transition rules for all legal states and same executable path; observed equality on development is insufficient; publish aliases and actual run count

ablation_contract.M-no-cal: public point retained; empty residual histories, fallback0; other mechanisms shared
ablation_contract.M-no-aging: only disables public T aging; other mechanisms shared

freeze_policy: G1 locks design and deterministic selection rules; G2/G3 validates implementations; G4 locks executable parameters/code/final trace hashes before final data.

predictor_candidate.point: tokenize text computed from actual public source and target list; add native EOS count1; max_tokens clip
predictor_candidate.fit: none for length point; calibration only for timing coefficients and initial residual fallback
predictor_candidate.initial_margin: per bucket max(0, actual_output_tokens-public_rule_point) over32 registered calibration completions, ceil; empirical only
predictor_candidate.effective_length: min(max_tokens, max(1, point + method_margin)); no public grammar floor or upper clip other than max_tokens
predictor_candidate.old_predictors: v7/v9/grammar-floor/upper-clip retained as historical evidence; not executable v4 contract

mechanism_contract.feedback: completed normal-EOS known-token measurement only; after native slot release; no future data; include factual errors as observed lengths but report quality separately
mechanism_contract.warm_history_order: calibration seed ascending then per-seed instance order; reset from same128 calibration records each run
mechanism_contract.quantile: type7; nonnegative positive residual; ceil; zero valid
mechanism_contract.NN_history: separate admission-wait history H128/min32, initially empty; not the four residual buckets

workload.preprocessing: public ID extraction; preserve source row order and instruction; all policies share it; preserve full raw source separately
workload.within_stratum_source_choice: alternate the two source instances; fixed seed-derived starting phase; preserve per-task allocation; merge in deterministic alternating task order
workload.historical_prompt_duplicates: stop before inference; no model-output-based filtering; amend source generation before reattempt with new run ID
workload.pilot_passed: v17 64/64; all four cells16/16; one serial service, no population/performance claim

quality_gate.pilot: v17 gate in configs/p1-copy-profile-v17.json must pass before recommending v4
quality_gate.formal_calibration: all128 complete with known tokens and natural EOS; whole correct>=122/128, each of4 buckets>=31/32; any failure stops freeze, no selective removal
quality_gate.formal_load: report correct/ALL230, all six terminals; never discard a run for poor task quality or performance

measurement.interactive_P95: planned arrival to first nonempty content over all200; interval/extended infinity for missing
measurement.background_P95: planned arrival to completion over all30; interval/extended infinity for missing
measurement.output_rate: all measured output tokens / max(100,last observed terminal seconds); unknown tokens=>lower bound, no pass claim
measurement.quantile: type7; latency endpoints and inclusive deadline order frozen atG2
measurement.complexity: decision CPU P50/P95/max, process CPU/RSS, state bytes, code delta, public preprocessing/tokenization/cache/observability cost; no invented human hours
measurement.front_end_boundary: raw request planned arrival precedes public extraction and feature lookup; all policies includingB0 share same front end; report preprocessing and tokenization/cache CPU cost, include actual online work in end-to-end latency

phase_ownership.G1: freeze scope and selection rules, not parameters or performance success
phase_ownership.G2: C++ design and lifecycle, common public preprocessing/parser, event ordering, capacity and state transitions
phase_ownership.G3: C++ baseline/controller correctness,128 actual calibration, release recovery, online causality, native mechanism witnesses and shared-budget serviceability; re-estimate logs/resources
phase_ownership.G4: finite development search, final parameter/code/hash freeze; generate final only after implementation and access gates
phase_ownership.G5: 20paired final blocks, complete matrix and intervals

resource_budget.calibration_upper_rule: 128*1.2*60/3600+15min service startup rounded up; no code/correctness debugging included
resource_budget.reestimate_at: G3 actual new C++ log volume; raw+zip+calibration reserve; source archive chain retained
